purpose: Measure how the frozen promoted forecast changes when complete XRS/proton input families are unavailable for consecutive daily forecast cycles, and compare existing simple handling arms without retraining or outcome-driven scenario movement.

interface_semantics.source: hash-pinned released SEP-Prediction-V2 daily model-ready table
interface_semantics.one_issue_row: one UTC daily forecast-input cycle summarizing the preceding 24 hours
interface_semantics.outage_interpretation: aggregate forecast-input family unavailable at consecutive daily issue cycles
interface_semantics.not_claimed: raw five-minute sensor-stream outage or causal high-cadence reaggregation

block_placement.rule: Choose deterministic positions over admissible contiguous daily source-clock starts bounded by the score-role time span.
block_placement.zero_exposure_rule: Preserve the declared block and report it as unevaluable/zero-exposure; never move it after seeing labels, availability or forecast outcomes.

cell_eligibility: Within a declared outage interval, hide only modality cells finite at the released aggregate interface. Pre-existing unavailable cells remain unavailable and are not counted as hidden reference values.
recovery_arm_disclosure: Causal forward-fill previously minimized probability drift in an already-inspected random finite-cell stress test. All three existing arms are retained here; this experiment is not an independent recovery-arm discovery test.

paired_uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: complete NEW-crossing event episode or predeclared quiet block

selection_rule: Report every modality x duration x recovery-arm scenario. Do not omit scenarios, blocks or policies based on outcomes, exposure or apparent favorability.

software_gate_before_data_execution.source_only_ci: must pass on pandas 2.3.2 and pandas 3.0.1

claim_boundary: Development-only aggregate-interface reliability experiment on already-inspected score identities. It cannot establish raw-sensor outage robustness, native-sensor reconstruction accuracy, strict prospective predictor causality, untouched final robustness, operational readiness, economic savings, company superiority, award outcome or a breakthrough.
